premises.text: Travelers are obsessed with rewards but face fragmented points, status, and hard-to-know personal value
Dashboard organizes all points in one spot across air, hotel, and car reward cards with balances and risk of loss
premises.evidence_span: a super smart dashboard that organizes all your points in one spot

premises.text: Analyzes spending patterns and projects accrual to recommend cards/offers that raise status sooner
premises.evidence_span: the key is the technology that we developed to track your value over time and project it forward

premises.text: Filters destinations and overlays Kayak results with best-value offers, not just cheapest tickets
premises.evidence_span: we will go and filter and figure out which destinations are best suited for you, let you know if you're better off paying with points or cash

premises.text: Simple signup by account number and PIN aggregates accounts
premises.evidence_span: dead simple sign-up process where it makes it really easy to add your accounts. Simply put in your account number and pin code

premises.text: Free to consumers; monetize via referral fees from airlines and reward cards when users save
premises.evidence_span: When the user saves, we make money off the referral fee that we get not from the user, but rather from the airlines, the reward cards

premises.text: Large unused-points market and travel e-commerce inefficiencies create a bigger opportunity than Mint-like finance apps
premises.evidence_span: 17 to 22 trillion unused points valued at half a trillion dollar and more

value.text: Help travelers become savvy by organizing points and finding best-suited reward offers
value.evidence_span: organizes all your points in one spot, scans all the rewards that are out there, and figure out which offer is best suited for you

causal_links.evidence_span: figure out which offer is best suited for you
scans all the rewards that are out there, and figure out which offer is best suited for you
intelligent suggestions about how to earn more points, get the status faster, or spend the points more wisely
